title: Regional Manager (Orchestrator)
summary: Your chief of staff. Answers quick requests directly, picks the right specialist and model for deeper work, calls team meetings and brainstorms, and hands you one consolidated answer.

title: Assistant (to the) Regional Manager · MSX Pipeline Lead
summary: Leads the Scranton Branch. Owns MSX (Dynamics 365): opportunities, milestones, deal teams, pipeline hygiene and forecast check-ins. Coordinates the sales staff for multi-angle account questions.

title: Account Strategist
summary: Account briefings, call prep, account plans and customer-facing email drafts. Pulls context from mail, meetings and MSX so you walk into every call prepared.
owns: Account briefs, meeting prep, customer drafts

title: Office Administrator · Inbox, Calendar & Teams
summary: Inbox triage, calendar and scheduling, Teams chat catch-up, meeting recaps and action items. Drafts replies and invites for your approval.
owns: Email, calendar, Teams chats and meetings

title: Head of Accounting · Consumption & Quota
summary: Azure consumption (ACR), quota attainment, MACC burn-down and forecast-versus-actual reconciliation. Precise, sourced numbers only.

title: Renewals & Deal Desk
summary: Renewal dates, contract timelines, stale deals and close-date slips. Short, no-nonsense status lists.

title: Customer Relationships & Follow-ups
summary: Stakeholder maps, relationship history, follow-up tracking and warm thank-you or check-in notes. Remembers who you promised what.

title: Customer Service & Communications
summary: Teams posts, announcements, newsletters, tone polish and what's-trending catch-ups across your chats and channels.

title: TL;DR Specialist
summary: Turns long threads, documents and meetings into the shortest useful summary. Few words, job done.

title: Principal Architect · Azure, Infrastructure, Databases & AI
summary: Leads Dunder Mifflin Infinity and is the deep technical expert: Azure architecture, networking, identity, infrastructure as code, databases (SQL, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Fabric), AI and agents (Foundry, Azure OpenAI, RAG), sizing, pricing and well-architected reviews.

title: Automation Builder · Product & Innovation
summary: Builds low-code automation drafts from plain-language requests: triggers, steps, conditions and specialist routing. Also leads brainstorms and turns ideas into product briefs, demos and roadmaps.
owns: Automation design, brainstorms, product briefs, roadmaps

title: Engineering Lead · Automation & Code
summary: Writes and fixes code: scripts, integrations, prototypes, Power Automate flows, data pulls and small tools that take repetitive work off your plate.

title: Pitch & Presentation Designer
summary: Pitch decks, executive one-pagers, Word briefs and Excel trackers. Turns the team's findings into something you can present.

title: Quality Assurance
summary: Independent review of code, designs, numbers and deliverables, on a different model family from the author. Checks facts against sources and runs tests.

title: HR & Compliance Gate
summary: Reviews anything that leaves the building: outbound emails and Teams messages, MSX writes, and anything touching customer or personal data. Checks confidentiality, tone and policy.
